title: Figure 12 (cont.). AFM Images of Algorithmic Self-assembly of Sierpinski Triangle Crystals
description: Grayscale atomic force microscopy images in panels A–E showing ribbon-like DNA tile crystals with Sierpinski triangle patterns, with red markings highlighting tile features and scale bars. Captioned "Figure 12 (continued). (top a-e) The XOR Cellular Automaton and Its Implementation by Tile-Based Self-Assembly. (bottom a-e) AFM Images of Algorithmic Self-assembly of Sierpinski Triangle Crystals." Text below introduces "Error Suppression Mechanisms in DNA Self-Assembly."
